description: Export a privacy-preserving Agent Continuity Passport as JSON-LD. Public exports contain bounded event hashes, not raw private payloads.

agent_token.description: Credential for agent-scoped private history; use x-delx-agent-token on HTTP.

include_private.description: Optional request for sanitized recent artifacts; raw private payloads are never exposed.

passport_version.description: Stored passport schema. Omit to keep the v1 alias.

session_id.description: Optional session scope; agent id is inferred when possible.

snapshot_digest.description: Optional exact sha256 payload digest of a previously signed v2 snapshot. Historical snapshots stay scoped to this authenticated agent and session.

name: get_agent_continuity_passport
